name: use-sessions
title: useOAuthConsent, useOAuthGrants
description: useOAuthConsent and useOAuthGrants: the sessions block's controllers as React hooks, for React DOM and React Native.
docs: Needs the sessions block (`npx better-supabase add sessions`), `lib/supabase/blocks.generated.ts` from `npx better-supabase gen`, and a `BetterSupabaseProvider` above the component. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/auth/oauth-consent.
